senses.gloss: m. (cmp. preced.) plate, tablet, merchant’s dish (in which the various coins are arranged). Tanḥ. Ki Thissa, ed. Bub. 1 (expl. אגן הסהר, Cant. VII, 3, with play on סהר and סחר) פ׳ של פרגמטיא וכ׳ the plate used in business, whatever one needs, comes out of it; [read:] ואין הלשון אגן אלא אשון פ׳ and the word aggan means dish (ref. to Ex. XXIV, 6); Yalk. Cant. 992 פתרין.
